name: James Pringle

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Constant's journal, 19 May 1785: 'Rode to Smith Clove; married James Prendle and Phebe Lamoreux.' Giles & Franklin give 9 May 1785.

events.title: Settled in Jackson Twp.
events.place: part of Plymouth Twp. now Jackson Twp., Luzerne Co., PA

bioAdditions: Rev. Silas Constant married 'James Prendle and Phebe Lamoreux' at Smith's Clove on 19 May 1785 (S1). Giles & Franklin say Phebe (1765-1856) was a daughter of John and Charity (Davenport) Lamoreux, lived with her sister Charity in Plymouth, Pa., and later with the Mekeels. They list three children: Charity (b. 31 Jan 1800, d. 1899, m. Oliver McKeel/Mekeel), Hannah, and Phebe, whose daughters were Elmira and Martha (Mrs. Clinton Brown) (S2). Harvey says James settled about 1797-98 in the part of Plymouth that became Jackson Twp., and that he was the father of Charity Mekeel (H0145) (S3). On p.135 Harvey calls Samuel and James Pringle brothers, 'presumably natives of Connecticut', who lived in Orange Co., N.Y., for several years before 1790.

conflicts.assessment: Prefer the officiating minister's journal: 19 May.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Marriage from the minister's journal; settlement and child from two secondary works.
